lines: // Called by the "run_script" action of msm_examples:chime_block.

meta.notes: The script that defines the handler msm_examples:chime with msm.actions.define. The handler receives the owner (the block's id), the event id, the position and the player who used the block, when there is one. It plays a chime whose pitch follows the world time, shows a note particle and tells the player the pitch. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the Java project export leaves them out.
